JUST IN: The Department of Foreign Affairs on Wednesday (Aug. 6, 2025) says the Consulate General of the Philippines in Hong Kong confirmed the death of a 35-year old Filipino tourist due to injuries sustained in a vehicular accident in Tsuen Wan West on Tuesday (Aug. 5). The deceased's remains are now housed in Kwai Chung Public Mortuary and the taxi driver involved in the accident is under police custody.

DFA: The Consulate General is currently assisting the family of the deceased and is anticipating their arrival in Hong Kong soon to arrange the shipment of remains. The Consulate General is closely coordinating with the Hong Kong Police Force while the official investigation of the case is ongoing. 

The Consulate General offers its deepest condolences to the deceased's family and prays for his eternal rest. | Marita Moaje

Kinumpirma ng Consulate General of the Philippines in Hong Kong na nasawi ang isang turistang Pilipino matapos masangkot sa vehicular accident sa Tsuen Wan West nitong Martes, August 5.

Nasa kustodiya na ng mga pulis ang taxi driver na sangkot sa disgrasya habang nakipag-ugnayan na ang Consulate General sa pamilya ng 35-anyos na biktima.

"The Consulate General is closely coordinating with the Hong Kong Police Force while the official investigation of the case is ongoing," saad sa pahayag.
